summary.content:
Today's selection covers 100 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Conversational Gemini navigation comes to Apple CarPlay
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ClickFix has never been bigger, and AI tools are its most convincing lure yet
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 59 articles published in the last 24 hours
